title: Salacious B. Crumb
franchise: Star Wars: Return of the Jedi
description: Upon the platform of Jabba's throne, nestled by the Hutt's tail, one could frequently find Salacious B. Crumb—the source of shrill cackling that would echo through the throne room. The Kowakian Monkey-Lizard sat on Jabba's dais, stealing food, mimicking his master, denizens of the court, and other visitors, and otherwise making a nuisance of himself. This won him favor with the gangster and the unofficial post of the court jester of the palace.
